subject: Quick recap & proposed deployment pathways — Garnet Analytics discovery
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@garnetanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Sep 2024 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap & proposed deployment pathways — Garnet Analytics discovery

Hi Liam —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery so the team has a single source of truth:

- Goals: reduce inference latency for customer-facing search (target P95 < 120ms), improve throughput for batch embedding jobs, and ensure data residency for EU-origin requests.
- Constraints: Garnet needs audit logs and KMS-managed keys for model requests; procurement typically takes 6–8 weeks for pilot POs.
- Current leaning: interested in Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) for predictable throughput, with a potential VPC/private deployment down the line for data residency.

Based on that, proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a short mutual action plan (MAP) and two pricing sketches (Dedicated vs. Private/VPC) by Monday.
2) Can you confirm whether the legal/security team will need SOC2 + short SAML review before pilot?
3) If the pilot is a priority for Q4, what internal approvals/timeline should we expect?

I attached a one-page MAP draft that captures what we discussed. If you want, we can also route a one-hour technical workshop with our infra engineer (Karthik) to nail down the KMS/audit questions.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: garnet-map-draft.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@garnetanalytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Sep 2024 09:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap & proposed deployment pathways — Garnet Analytics discovery

Evelyn —

Appreciate the recap and the MAP. On the security side, yes: SOC 2 evidence is required and our infra team will want details on KMS integration and IP allowlisting. Two quick Qs before we go deeper:

1) For the Dedicated option, can you confirm whether we can get dedicated VPC peering and customer-managed keys, or are those only available in Private deployments?
2) Do you have any references for companies in finance/legal who have onboarded to a Private deployment recently?

Procurement note: we typically target pilot PO approvals within 6 weeks, but I’ll check and confirm.

Thanks —
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform, Garnet Analytics
liam@garnetanalytics.com

Date: Thu, 12 Sep 2024 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap & proposed deployment pathways — Garnet Analytics discovery

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the quick reaction. Short answers up front:
- Dedicated: supports reserved-capacity GPU pools and network controls, but customer-managed KMS and full private networking (VPC with customer CIDR) are only available in our Private deployment offering.
- References: I’m including a two-line anonymized reference (finance customer) in the attached outline; can share an intro after NDAs if that helps.

Attached is a VPC pilot outline that shows a lightweight path: a 4-week Private pilot (on a customer-controlled VPC peering) that we can run with isolated logging and KMS. It also includes an expected procurement checklist and a starter SOW template.

Suggested immediate actions:
- If you want the Private pilot: confirm security lead and procurement contact so we can kick off our legal/infra sync.
- If you prefer to start with Dedicated: we can get you a capacity hold and a short performance baseline to validate latency/throughput before committing to Private.

Which approach sounds better for Garnet’s Q4 window? We can align on the right kickoff date once you confirm.

—Evelyn
Attachment: vpc-pilot-outline.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@garnetanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Sep 2024 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Gentle pulse on Private pilot interest and next steps

Hi Liam —

Wanted to check in briefly — we haven’t heard back on the VPC pilot outline I sent on the 12th and I wanted to confirm next steps before we allocate resources. Quick checklist so you can forward to your internal stakeholders if helpful:

- Confirmed priority: Is a Private/VPC pilot still in scope for Q4? (Yes / No / Delayed)
- Security contact: Who on your security/compliance team should we loop in for SOC2 evidence and KMS integration?
- Procurement window: Do you expect a pilot PO within 6 weeks or do we need to plan for a later start?

If it helps, we can also:
- Hold a short 30-minute tech sync next week with Marcus (our solutions lead) to answer the KMS/peering questions live.
- Put a temporary capacity hold on Dedicated while you decide, to guarantee baseline latency tests.

If I don’t hear back by the end of next week, I’ll assume you’re pausing for now and we’ll circle back in a month. No pressure — just want to make sure we’re aligned.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
